title: Tighten paper lookup precision
description: Fixes version-number false positives in arc_lookup_paper by separating meaningful core-token matching from weak version-token evidence.
changes: Do not let version tokens such as 1.5 dominate candidate scoring.
Require at least one meaningful non-version query token to match title, abstract, snippet, URL, DOI, or arXiv ID.
Allow fuzzy long-token matching for typo-tolerant paper-name lookup without hard-coded title rewrites.
Keep query variants generic: original phrase plus hyphen/space normalization only.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous scripts/paper_lookup.py scoring and query variant logic.
